# Lib.image.generate.load

## Operators

- [**ImageSequenceClip**](ImageSequenceClip.md) — Loads an image sequence from a folder and adds it as a time clip bar within the DopeView of the Timeline, similar to how video editing apps show clips.
- [**LoadImage**](LoadImage.md) — Loads an image file as a Texture2D.
- [**LoadImageFromUrl**](LoadImageFromUrl.md) — Loads an image file with the specified URL. This process does not use caching.
- [**LoadSvgAsTexture2D**](LoadSvgAsTexture2D.md) — Loads a SVG file as a Texture2D.
